apps.name: Spektra Cam
apps.subtitle: 胶片相机 · Physically based film camera
apps.localizedDescription:
SpektraLab（Mac 胶片冲洗软件）的非官方 iPhone 版：用同一个胶片物理引擎冲洗照片——胶片曝光、染料层、颗粒、光晕、放大机与相纸一路算下来。带 ProRAW 相机、30 款胶片、暗房编辑、观片台，中英双语。

An unofficial iPhone port of SpektraLab, the Mac film-developing app: photos are developed by the same physical film engine — exposure, dye layers, grain, halation, enlarger and paper. ProRAW camera, 30 film stocks, darkroom editor, light table; Chinese and English.

versions.localizedDescription:
中英双语：整个 App 跟着手机语言显示中文或英文。
Chinese and English: the whole app follows your iPhone's language.

前置相机用方形传感器（ProRAW、横竖拍、0.6×）；片边照片能导出；反转片直接扫描；胶片按类型排。
Front camera on its square sensor (ProRAW, portrait/landscape, 0.6×); film-edge exports fixed; slides scanned; films grouped by type.

颜色和 Mac 版一致；拍完后台冲洗；进编辑更快；去掉底部导航栏。
Colour matches the Mac app; shots develop in the background; faster editor; no tab bar.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Spektra Cam 用相机拍照，拍下的照片会放进你的图库，按装好的胶卷冲洗。
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Spektra Cam 需要保存你冲洗出的照片到相册。
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: 来源设为“系统相册”时，Spektra Cam 直接读取相册里的原图来冲洗，不会改动它们。
